adaptiveIcon._comment: foregroundImage is the WHITE symbol, so the background must be the brand blue — it was #E6F4FE (Expo's light blue), which would have rendered a white mark on a near-white field. backgroundImage is intentionally omitted: it overrides backgroundColor, and Expo's default was placeholder art.

android._queriesComment: Android 11+ hides other apps unless they are declared here. Without this, Linking.canOpenURL/openURL fails for UPI apps even when they ARE installed, and Razorpay checkout dead-ends at 'web page not available'.

plugins._comment: Brand blue is only safe here because splash-icon.png is the WHITE knockout. The full-colour logo is itself #014eb4, so it would vanish into this background — never point this at the colour mark.
